slot_ownership.main_run: native form POST reloads the page; no in-page response competes

stale_policy.effect: ignored; only ignoredStaleResponses and lastIgnored change
stale_policy.abort_controller: not used; synchronous Flask handlers keep running and abort would only hide outcomes

undo_success_rule: success === true and backup_id equal to the sent receipt and transaction_id present (equal to the sent one when sent) and restored_sha256 is 64 lowercase hex; otherwise failed with the backend code, undo_failed, or undo_receipt_incomplete

chat_execution.source: server forces retrieve for web_mode=chat; Chat never applies

mode_model.instant_execution: last explicit #modeSelect/#applyPolicy choice; hydrated from the server-rendered form

primary_action.hint: states the owned execution mode and apply policy

entry_behavior.ux02_repositories: late repository-A response replaced candidate B and usage; Test sent A's patch with repo_path B
entry_behavior.ux02_same_repository: older response replaced the newer candidate
entry_behavior.ux03: success:false (audit exact) and a real stale_target refusal both recorded 'undone'
entry_behavior.ux04: Full + Ask before apply -> Chat -> Instant Run became Retrieve + Plan only, button Run
entry_behavior.raw_json_innertext: Test/Apply/Undo/Critique read #patchRawJson.innerText, empty while the Patch tab is visible and Raw JSON is collapsed; Test Run Patch sent nothing

post_behavior.ux02: stale responses ignored (context_changed / superseded); candidate, usage, answer, review and controls stay bound to the current context
post_behavior.ux03: every non-confirmed Undo response is a failed action with its code; a real success is 'undone'
post_behavior.ux04: Instant configuration survives Chat round trips; submit carries exactly the displayed execution

limitations: Editing the repository input invalidates the displayed candidate on the first changed character; typing the old path back does not restore it (reload the session).
A mutation response made stale by a repository switch is recorded only in debug telemetry and in the server's persisted session/backup state.
Generate still combines the displayed run's CONTROL context with the current repository input.
Repository-scoped auxiliary panels outside the candidate workflow (Dream runs, benchmarks, evidence pack) keep their own request handling.
UX-05: a missing Mermaid CDN still stops the page script before hydration; UX-06 keyboard/focus remains open.

performance.method: Chromium, real page with the subscribed renderer; median per-operation microseconds of 9 batches x 200 operations, median of 3 runs. mode_round_trip is two transitions (Chat, Instant); stale_request_settle is begin + repository invalidation + ignored settle. No network request is issued by any transition.
performance.requests: every scenario asserts its exact POST count; a second Undo while one is pending issues no request
